question: What does Ichthyology deal with?
solution:
The correct answer is the __**Study of fish.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ichthyology **__

 __
 
• **Ichthyology** is the **branch of zoology** which deals with the** study of fish, including bony fish, cartilaginous fish, and jawless fish**.
 
• The study of fish dates from the Upper Paleolithic Revolution. 
 
• The science of ichthyology was developed in several interconnecting epochs, each with various significant advancements.
 
• The study of fish receives its origins from humans' desire to feed, clothe, and equip themselves with useful implements
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **study of reptiles and amphibians** is a branch of zoology called **Herpetology.**
 
• The **branch of zoology** which deals with the **study of birds is called ornithology.**
 
• **Entomology** is known as the **study of insects.**
